Reliability & Incidents.name: Outage root cause & remediation
Reliability & Incidents.definition: Technical cause of a platform outage or degradation and the engineering fixes (failover, circuit breakers, monitoring, post-mortems).

Reliability & Incidents.name: Outage business impact & trust
Reliability & Incidents.definition: Effect of an outage on the customer: lost visibility, audit/regulatory exposure, eroded confidence, escalations.

Reliability & Incidents.name: Incident communication
Reliability & Incidents.definition: How (or whether) customers were notified and kept informed during and after an incident.

Reliability & Incidents.name: SLAs & service credits
Reliability & Incidents.definition: Uptime commitments, SLA breaches, credits and contractual reliability terms.

Product Gaps.name: Detect alert quality
Product Gaps.definition: Alert latency, missed alerts, false positives and alert fatigue in Detect.

Product Gaps.name: Integrations & connectors
Product Gaps.definition: SIEM (LogVault), cloud and backup connectors: setup effort, timeouts, data gaps, configuration complexity.
Product Gaps.note: No single cluster - spread across 6, 8, 13 and noise; added because integrations recur in support and competitive calls.

Product Gaps.name: Identity authentication & access
Product Gaps.definition: SSO/SAML, MFA, LDAP/SCIM provisioning, login failures and access management in Identity.

Product Gaps.name: Backup & restore performance
Product Gaps.definition: Protect backup windows, throughput, restore granularity and recovery reliability.

Product Gaps.name: Compliance audit preparation
Product Gaps.definition: Using Comply to prepare for audits: evidence collection, manual effort, readiness reviews.

Product Gaps.name: Compliance framework coverage
Product Gaps.definition: Which frameworks Comply supports and how well (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), custom templates, adoption of Comply v2.

Product Gaps.name: Compliance report quality & performance
Product Gaps.definition: Defects, control-mapping errors, formatting issues and slow or timing-out report generation.

Commercial.name: Renewal & pricing
Commercial.definition: Renewal terms, pricing, discounts, multi-year deals, upsell/expansion and downgrade discussions.

Commercial.name: Billing disputes & overages
Commercial.definition: Invoice errors, seat or usage overages, proration and unexpected charges.

Commercial.name: Competitive pressure
Commercial.definition: Customers evaluating or comparing competitors, and internal competitive strategy.
Commercial.note: Split out of cluster 13 ('Outage fallout and competitive risk'): competitor mentions matter to sales independently of the outage.

Customer Experience.name: Onboarding & adoption
Customer Experience.definition: Deployment kickoffs, implementation effort, rollout plans and feature adoption.

Customer Experience.name: Support experience
Customer Experience.definition: Support responsiveness, escalation paths, workarounds and case handling quality.

Customer Experience.name: Roadmap & feature requests
Customer Experience.definition: Requested capabilities, roadmap timelines and commitments to customers.

Engineering & Delivery.name: Release quality & regressions
Engineering & Delivery.definition: Bugs introduced by releases or patches, QA/test gaps, regressions and side effects of fixes.
Engineering & Delivery.note: QA gaps were mixed into cluster 15 and remediation side effects fell into noise; separated because they are an engineering-process signal.

Engineering & Delivery.name: Scalability & capacity planning
Engineering & Delivery.definition: Load, scale limits, engineering bandwidth, sprint/quarter planning and prioritisation.
